title: a2dlc lint of an S* contract (.a2dlc/run/<slice>/lint.json)
description: Stage 1.5 step 1 (§5): the deterministic check of contract.json, without LLM. ok is false if there is at least one finding of error; with error the stage escalates before spending on Z3 or on the back-translation. contract_hash is the sha256 of contract.json as it was read: a lint.json with another hash is stale. trace_coverage is the clause coverage gate: each post and invariant of S* must have a probe that names it (rule in rule).

rule.description: The textual rule by which a probe covers a clause, written by the core.

severity.description: error if intent.json declares criticality high or critical; warning otherwise.

check.description: contract: contract.json does not decode or does not validate. function_exists: a function of S* is not among the candidate's signatures. duplicate_function: two functions with the same name. empty_clause: a pre, post or invariant that is blank. no_postcondition: a function with no post or invariants (it says nothing). probe_function: a probe that names no function of S*. pi_s: incoherent π_S. open_assumption: an open assumption of criticality high or critical. trace_coverage: a post or invariant without a probe. smt: what Z3 said (unknown, skipped, or the engine down).

where.description: Function, probe, assumption or clause: what to look at.
